title: Deployment-run QA
summary: Acceptance and execution use complete frozen item-case selections; attached post-deploy plans run as plan groups. Authorized withdrawals and replacements retain source ancestry and target checks. An incomplete historical selection names operator repair recovery; raw historical requirements and results remain viewable without current-definition reinterpretation. A member walks only its own item cases on its own scoped cursor. Each plan group is gated as a run-scoped subject and closes on its own; member acceptance never waits on group rows, and an item is done only once a closed group covers it. --plan at item-qa names the plan's open group without adding obligations or refreshing live content; no command selects one member's plan cases. New plans fill empty stages; explicit corrections retain replacement validation. A selector conflicting with a private member cursor names the existing execution and owner-resume recovery while retaining custody. Removal retracts an open group with no attaching member left, never its passed rows; a retracted group is never reused.
